lines.text: Many learners say: He is enough old to drive.
Better: He is old enough to drive.
The second! He is old enough to drive.

native.tip: Türkçede “yeterince büyük” deriz; İngilizcede “enough” sözcüğü “old” sözcüğünden sonra gelir: “He is old enough to drive.”
native.caption: “He is enough old to drive” mi diyorsun? 😅 “Enough” sözcüğü “old” sözcüğünden sonra gelir. Doğrusu “He is old enough to drive.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “old enough”. “Enough” sözcüğünü “old” sözcüğünden sonra kullan. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: “Enough” comes after “old”: “He is old enough to drive.”
en.caption: Do you say “He is enough old to drive”? 😅 In English enough comes after the word, not before it. The right sentence is “He is old enough to drive.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
